topic: Managing 15 client companies from a WhatsApp group — what breaks and when
format: Walk through a day-in-the-life of an HR team managing this manually — show every broken step in sequence
post:
8:15 AM. Your phone has 34 unread WhatsApp messages across 6 client groups.

One is asking about a work permit status.
One needs a salary certificate today.
Three want to know if their WPS payroll Oman submission went through.
And somewhere in that thread — a visa expiry nobody flagged.

This is the morning for most HR teams managing 10+ client companies manually.

No dashboard. No alerts. No audit trail.
Just screenshots, forwarded PDFs, and a spreadsheet that's already three days behind.

By noon, something slips. It always does.

A Ministry of Labour Oman compliance deadline gets missed. An employee's end-of-service gratuity is calculated wrong. A client calls angry — and you have no record of what was promised or when.

The problem isn't your team's effort.
It's that the system was never built for this volume.

WhatsApp is a messaging app. It was never an operations platform.

When you're managing 15 companies, you need every work permit, payroll run, SPF filing, and contract in one place — with timestamps, not thread searches.
